The returned template seems to be for converting an alcohol to ester? The retro_smarts_template: '[#8:1]-[C;H0;D3;+0:2](-[C:3])=[O;H0;D1;+0:4]>>[#8:1]-[CH;D3;+0:2](-[C:3])-[OH;D1;+0:4]' This is reverse of ester formation: ester -> alcohol + acid? Actually product side is carbonyl (C=O) attached to O, reactant side is alcohol. So retro template: ester -> alcohol + acid. Good.

Now apply this template to target.
